title: Scheme extension problems and normalized polynomial extension classes
statement: For a scheme arrow $f:X\to S$, a base thickening $i:S\to S\prime$ and a module sheaf $G$, use the extension problem for the canonical inverse-image reduction $f^{-1}\mathcal O_{S\prime}\to f^{-1}\mathcal O_S$ and structure map to $\mathcal O_X$. A solution torsor is an additive Ext-one action on its solution classes, with zero, addition and unique translation. A realization by a marked lift identifies its solution ring with the inverse image of the lift structure sheaf, its quotient with the marking map, its kernel with the normalized lift kernel, and its base map on all inverse-image local base sections with pullback along the lift projection. Restricting scalars of a ring-sheaf extension along a reduction is the actual extension with the composite base map. Interpret a recorded normalized polynomial-conormal representative of an extension in any chosen sheaf derived localization as $Q(\pi)Q(c)^{-1}Q(\delta)$ followed by the canonical degree-minus-one single-object shift isomorphism. A split lift extension is an extension over the original field with ring, quotient and kernel identified with the actual marked lift through the coefficient isomorphism, and base map given by the split-base projection on all local sections. Dependencies: [def-sfb-scheme-lift-classification-data], [def-sfb-zariski-square-zero-extension-problems], [lem-sfb-zariski-sheaf-algebra-extension-ext].
